BiblicalUsage: The word is produce, the fruit of the land. God made Israel suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock, and to eat the increase of the fields; the fig tree says, Shall I leave my sweetness and my good fruit, and go to be promoted over the trees; and Isaiah says Israel shall blossom and bud, and fill the face of the world with fruit.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the increase of the fields is God's gift, and the fig tree knew better than to leave it for a crown.
